notes.title: UnLoop Demo
notes.content:
Hi!
As mentioned before, UnLoop is taking part in the VR Forever Steam Festival. 

We’ve got a PCVR demo ready, and though right now its Steam page is still stuck in the review queue – you can grab the demo directly and give it a try.


How to run it:
Step 1: Download the .zip (download link is in our Discord – https://discord.gg/HQfWKaXqx6 #unloop-news channel, and extract it into a folder)

Step 2: Connect your headset and start SteamVR

Step 3: Run the game’s .exe from the folder you just extracted


Works with: 
Meta Quest & Pico headsets. Support for more headsets and controllers is planned for the full release.


The demo includes 8 introductory levels 
Where you can test your skills, get used to the gameplay loop, and try out the first two puzzle mechanics: cards and batteries!

Visuals in the demo are identical to those on the Meta Quest 3/3S because this demo is a port of the standalone version of the game. We plan to improve these for the full PCVR release.
